extracted.name: Baked Brie with Quebec Maple Syrup
extracted.description: Baked brie with maple syrup is a simple, delicious appetizer. Warm a wheel of Brie cheese with walnuts and maple syrup and serve it with sliced baguette at your next gathering, or to cheer on your favorite Canadian team.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups real maple syrup (fine light grade)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C).
Place the unwrapped Brie cheese in a baking dish, sprinkle with walnuts, and pour maple syrup over the walnuts and cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese warms and softens, about 10 minutes. Serve cheese with slices of baguette.
